Year 10 Mathematics 2027 › Topic 8: Probability
Topic 8

Probability

3 lessons + 1 revision session · Assessment: CT#6 (with Trigonometry) · Term 3 week 9

The interactive lessons for this topic are still being built. This page shows what the course covers, taken from the handbook.

3 lessons: 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, 8.5

8.1 Textbook pp. 476–487
  • Calculate the probability of a single event as either a fraction, decimal or percentage.
  • Problems could be set involving extracting information from tables or graphs.
8.2
  • Understand and use the probability scale from 0 to 1.
8.3
  • Understand that the probability of an event occurring = 1 – the probability of the event not occurring.
8.4
  • Understand relative frequency as an estimate of probability.
  • Expected frequency of occurrences.
8.5 Textbook pp. 488–492
  • Calculate the probability of simple combined events, using possibility diagrams, tree diagrams and Venn diagrams.
  • In possibility diagrams, outcomes will be represented by points on a grid, and in tree diagrams, outcomes will be written at the end of branches and probabilities by the side of the branches.
  • Venn diagrams will be limited to two sets.
